extensions.description: HELM episode protocol. The first message carries a helm.episode.v1 data part; progress and mirrors stream back; an INPUT_REQUIRED status parks the episode; the episode ends COMPLETED only after helm_work_report was applied.
HELM retained-task controls. Each verb declares actual support and an unavailable reason. Cancel is terminal and never represents pause.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: Per-episode secret placed in the sandbox environment (HELM_A2A_BEARER_TOKEN). It authenticates the control plane to this worker; the episode token for the model gateway is a different secret.

skills.name: HELM episode
skills.description: Runs one bounded episode of a HELM organization seat: the agent works only through the HELM MCP tools and model gateway named in the episode, and reports through helm_work_report.
